{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the number of unique channels
channels = df['channel'].unique()
print(f'Unique channels: {channels}')

# Check the dtype of revenue
print(f'Dtype of revenue column: {df["revenue"].dtype}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = df[df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {refunded_count}')

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Display first few rows of QA orders
qa_orders.head()"}
